title: Is this official?
line: No. IntPortal is an independent student project. It isn't made by or affiliated with any school, and only works with your own account.

title: Is my password safe?
line: It never leaves your phone except to sign in to your school's own portal. It's kept in the phone's keychain, and the app makes at most three sign-in tries every fifteen minutes so it can never lock your SIS account.

title: Does it work offline?
line: Yes. After one sign-in, your schedule, grades, deadlines, notes and decks are on the phone. It syncs again when you have signal.

title: Is it free?
line: Yes: free to download and use, with no ads. The code is published on GitHub so anyone can read it; it isn't open for reuse, so copying or changing it needs permission.

title: Why isn't it on the App Store?
line: Publishing there needs a paid Apple developer account. Until then, you can sideload it with AltStore or SideStore: you need a Mac or Windows computer once to set it up, a free Apple ID runs at most 3 sideloaded apps, and you refresh it every 7 days. Or try it in the browser, no install.

title: What about other schools?
line: More are coming. The portal wall already lists other schools' portals, and today PUP's SIS and eMabini sign in.

title: Does the AI send my notes anywhere?
line: No. LAR's assistant runs on the phone itself, and you turn it on yourself. Your questions and notes stay on the phone.

title: It says to wait before signing in again
line: After three tries in fifteen minutes the app stops and tells you when you can try again. It never retries a rejected password on its own, so it can't get your school account locked. If you forgot the password, Forgot password opens your portal's own reset page.

title: The SIS isn't answering
line: A chip under the portal says so; it checks without sending your login. Everything you already have still opens offline. Pull down on Today to sync again once the SIS is back.

title: Reminders don't come
line: Turn them on in You, then check that your phone allows notifications for IntPortal in its Settings.

title: The iPhone app stopped opening
line: Apps signed with a free Apple ID stop opening after 7 days. Open AltStore or SideStore and refresh IntPortal; your data stays.

title: The Mac says it can't open IntPortal
line: The Mac build isn't signed yet. The first time, open it from the right-click menu and choose Open.

title: Windows says it protected your PC
line: That's SmartScreen, because the build isn't signed. Choose More info, then Run anyway.

title: Moving to a new phone
line: Make a backup in You and open it on the new phone, or just sign in again: your schedule and grades come back from the SIS. Your own notes and decks are only in the backup.
